text: {"reconstruction":3,"feasibility":2,"rationale":"The proposal gets the overall goal and the email template right, but it has no blog parameter or step for opening the blog in a new tab, it adds an unneeded recipient_email parameter, and it ends with \"Send/save the draft\" when the true workflow says never to send and to click Discard, so an automation built from it would be wrong and risky."}

data.rationale: The proposal gets the overall goal and the email template right, but it has no blog parameter or step for opening the blog in a new tab, it adds an unneeded recipient_email parameter, and it ends with "Send/save the draft" when the true workflow says never to send and to click Discard, so an automation built from it would be wrong and risky.
